hypothesis: In the pooled Korean caution short (korea_caution_hedged), the trades taken while the coin's Korean wallets are suspended in both directions (deposits and withdrawals) lose on average; skipping them improves the book. A skip is a flat position (0%), so the filtered book differs from the baseline only by the skipped trades.

development_evidence.sample: 38 Upbit caution events (2022-11 to 2026-10) with a 7-day plain short return from data/research/korea_composite_20261029/run_04/event_matrix.csv and a readable Upbit designation notice body
development_evidence.text_rule: wallet_rule_v2 below (the first, looser pattern also matched the section heading '입출금 일시 중단 안내' in two deposit-only notices, RESOLV 2026-03-23 and KERNEL 2026-04-20; it was corrected by reading those notices, after the returns were already known)
development_evidence.without_INIT_and_INJ: the other 9 both-suspended events average about -0.2%: the evidence is mostly two tail losses (INIT -43%, INJ -34%), so the expected benefit is tail avoidance rather than a steady edge
development_evidence.status: post hoc split found while investigating the INIT loss; the pooled forward ledger had 6 settled trades (INIT among them). This ledger is its first independent test. The plain short returns above are not the hedged returns this ledger is judged on.

source.access: read-only: the overlay never writes the baseline file or changes its trades, statistics or retirement
source.eligible: a source trade with a perpetual symbol, not backfilled, not late, discovered by the source at or after this ledger's activation, and not present in the source file at activation
source.entry: the source's entry close: 00:00 UTC after the designation's UTC day (day0 + 1 day)
source.returns: the source's own settled figures: hedged_return_pct (primary; short coin + long frozen top-30 basket, fees and funding) and return_pct (plain short, reference)

evidence.window: observations from the first cycle that sees the source trade until the entry close; anything received at or after the entry close is ignored

upbit_notice_arm.match: title designates a caution item ('유의 종목 지정', not '지정 해제') and names the coin in parentheses (same rule as the baseline's caution_tickers); first_listed_at between day0 - 7 days and the entry close
upbit_notice_arm.body: GET announcements/{id}; HTML tags and   removed, whitespace collapsed; each notice is classified once, from the first body received
upbit_notice_arm.hit: any matched notice whose body matches any wallet_rule_v2 pattern

bithumb_wallet_arm.endpoint: GET api.bithumb.com/public/assetsstatus/multichain/ALL (Bithumb notice bodies are behind bot protection and cannot be read)
bithumb_wallet_arm.coin_closed: every listed network of the coin has deposit_status 0 and withdrawal_status 0
bithumb_wallet_arm.valid_snapshot: at most 2% of listed currencies are closed in both directions (on 2026-10-31 15:05 UTC a maintenance window showed 29 of 523, BTC and ETH included; on 2026-11-01 only CORE and INIT)
bithumb_wallet_arm.hit: a run of valid snapshots showing the coin closed whose first and last are at least 60 minutes apart; a valid snapshot showing it open (or not listed) ends the run; failed or invalid snapshots neither extend nor end it

decision.time: the entry close; the decision uses only observations received before it and is journaled at the first cycle after it
decision.skip: upbit_notice_arm hit or bithumb_wallet_arm hit (the arm is recorded)
decision.keep: otherwise, including when sources failed: the filter acts only on evidence it holds; evidence coverage is reported
decision.late: no observation before the entry close (for example the web service was down): excluded from both books

books.baseline: every decided (keep or skip) source trade with a settled hedged return
books.filtered: the same trades; a skipped trade counts 0%
books.void: source trade ends no_perp, delisted, missing, or settled without a hedged return: excluded from both books

analysis.unit: episode = settled trades sharing an entry close and an action (keep or skip); episode return = mean hedged return of its trades
analysis.primary: mean hedged return of skipped episodes versus kept episodes; the filter helps when skipped < kept and skipped < 0
analysis.test: one-sided permutation of the episode labels (10,000 draws, numpy default_rng seed 20261101), statistic mean(kept) - mean(skipped)
analysis.review: at 10 settled skipped episodes, or 365 days after activation, whichever first; before that the summary is descriptive only and no p-value is shown

verdict.supported: skipped mean < 0, skipped mean < kept mean, and p <= 0.10
verdict.insufficient: fewer than 5 settled skipped episodes (or no kept episode) at the review

analysis.reported: per-book mean, worst trade, stop count (-40% stops), skips by arm, evidence coverage, plain-short reference
analysis.no_tuning: no change of patterns, thresholds, cadence or window after activation; a change needs a new protocol id and directory

limits: Rare events: the development sample had 11 in four years of Upbit notices; the pooled ledger may need about a year to reach the review.
Upbit wallet status is only read from notice text (its wallet API needs an account key); a freeze announced in a separate notice without wording in the designation notice is missed by the Upbit arm.
Bithumb notice text is unreadable; the Bithumb arm relies on a public status endpoint that has shown maintenance-wide closures.
The source tracker's own rules (entry, stop, basket, dedupe) are inherited; if it stops creating trades, this ledger stops receiving events.

integrity.journal: data/research/korea_frozen_skip_v1/journal.jsonl, append-only and hash-chained; each record carries the SHA-256 of this file and core/research/korea_frozen_skip_ledger.py; any change stops the journal
integrity.paper_only: records only; never places or proposes orders
